title: lithocardium scouleri
intro: Lithocardium scouleri, commonly known as Scouler's heartleaf, is a plant species that belongs to the family Rosaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including the ability to lower blood pressure and prevent cardiovascular disease, due to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lithocardium scouleri are attributed to its ability to relax vascular smooth muscles, thereby reducing blood pressure and improving cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
